page.overview:
Who is Inojin Yamanaka?

Inojin is the only child of Ino and Sai Yamanaka. As his parents continued to stay close to their childhood friends over the years, Inojin ultimately came to know the various parents' respective kids well. From a young age, Inojin would often have sleepovers with Chōchō and Shikadai, even having matching pyjamas. Their parents would also continue Asuma Sarutobi's tradition of taking the kids to Yakiniku Q to celebrate accomplishments. On the day of the Seventh Hokage's inauguration, he watched the ceremony with his parents and Shikadai.

Inojin seems rather obedient and the most reasonable of the new generation of the Ino–Shika–Chō trio, as he, unlike his teammates, insisted on going to training to learn the Ino–Shika–Chō techniques. At the same time, he can be very blunt and indifferent to people, situations and the feelings of those involved even to the point of being condescending. He also seems to have inherited the role of being the most motivated of the trio from his mother, Ino, and his late grandfather Inoichi. Because of his nature, Inojin is a very alert individual with outstanding powers of observation. Likewise, he is shown to be a very level-headed and adaptable person, able to calmly accept the surreal nature of a situation and act accordingly.

Despite regularly practising his respective parents' ninjutsu skills, mainly his father's, Inojin is always looking for a newer and more stylish means to go about it. At the same time, he has very simple goals in life, hoping to make more practical use of his skills for better financial gain. Later, Inojin developed romantic feelings for Himawari Uzumaki.

His outfit as an academy student consisted of a violet sweater and white overalls, regular shinobi sandals and a brown strap to hold his tantō identical to Sai. Three years after Boruto's departure from Konoha, Inojin wore a large, baggy full-sleeved top with a wide, raised collar along with a bag strapped diagonally across his torso from his left shoulder to his right hip. He wore light shorts that reach past his knees and dark, long socks or leggings under his shorts, finished off with light shinobi sandals.
